title: Giving Your Gifts
description: In today’s Soul Snack, Gary Zukav guides you through a powerful four-minute meditation on the concept of meaning.
This brief meditation encourages deep reflection on how we define meaning in our lives and how that definition can either be rooted in love or fear.

Gary explores the distinction between finding meaning through external identities—such as occupations, roles, and relationships—and finding a deeper, unshakable meaning that emerges from the gifts our souls are here to give.
Through this practice, you’ll be invited to shift from fear-based definitions of meaning to a more profound, multi-sensory understanding of your existence and your purpose.
As you listen, you’ll gain a fresh perspective on how love and fear shape our understanding of meaning and how embracing love leads to a more expansive, connected experience of life.
Gary also touches on the evolving consciousness that is reshaping humanity, offering a glimpse into the epic transformation of human awareness.
